name: Outdoor sensor enclosure
description: A small ABS box for an outdoor sensor, mounted on a fence post by a bar.

parts.name: Enclosure
parts.purpose: keeps rain and sun off the board

assembly.action: Clip the board onto the standoffs inside the shell
Bolt the bar to the bottom of the shell

scenarios.title: Grass fire nearby for a minute
Post shaken by a fan motor at 25 Hz
